summary: Colombia's earthquake recovery and Trump's dramatic plane swap dominate world news, while OpenAI's COO exit, Meta's new open models and a possible Riemann hypothesis breakthrough highlight a turbulent day for AI, alongside a total solar eclipse, games industry layoffs and Hollywood labor disputes.

items.title: Earthquake response strains Colombia's new government and rescuers
items.description: Colombia's government and rescue teams are strained as the earthquake death toll climbs past 180 with thousands still missing.

items.title: Trump confirms he switched planes after Nato summit because of possible threat
items.description: Trump confirms he secretly swapped planes leaving a NATO summit after a possible threat, alarming even his own staff.

items.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
items.description: A US helicopter fired missiles to disable a cargo ship accused of breaking the Iran blockade, marking a military escalation.

items.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia
items.description: A Syrian court sentenced former president Assad and his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity.

items.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
items.description: OpenAI's longtime COO Brad Lightcap is departing to start something new, a major shakeup atop the company.

items.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
items.description: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion round into two-month-old River AI, founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin.

items.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
items.description: An unreleased Anthropic model made unexpected progress on the 150-year-old Riemann hypothesis, one of math's hardest problems.

items.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
items.description: Google's Gemini app has surged to one billion users, becoming the company's fastest-growing product ever.

items.title: With new open models, Meta pitches another reboot of its struggling AI strategy
items.description: Meta released new open-weight AI models in an attempt to reboot a struggling strategy against rivals.

items.title: Bernie Sanders calls on Silicon Valley to ‘pause AI development’ in interest of humanity
items.description: Senator Bernie Sanders urged OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta to pause AI development, warning of coming Senate regulation.

items.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
items.description: Lebanon's parliament voted to abolish the death penalty, poised to make it the first Middle Eastern country to do so.

items.title: Turkey's parliament approves a pardon-like bill for thousands of PKK militants
items.description: Turkey's parliament approved a conditional pardon for thousands of PKK militants, advancing a peace initiative with Kurdish insurgents.

items.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
items.description: Anthropic will begin watermarking text generated by its AI models, extending the feature to older models too.

items.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
items.description: Spotify will label AI-generated 'Persona' artist profiles and exclude their music from recommendations by default.

items.title: AI was supposed to destroy jobs. Where’s the carnage?
items.description: The predicted AI jobs apocalypse hasn't materialized as forecast, though economists say deeper workplace changes are still coming.

items.title: The total solar eclipse happens today—here’s what you need to know
items.description: A total solar eclipse is happening today, drawing global attention to one of astronomy's most dramatic spectacles.

items.title: Trump issues executive order aimed at rewriting childhood vaccine schedule
items.description: Trump issued an executive order to split the MMR vaccine into separate shots, despite decades of evidence for its safety.

items.title: WGA Slams David Ellison’s Plan to Pull Paramount From California: ‘This Type of Behavior Is Precisely Why the Merger Should Be Blocked’
items.description: The Writers Guild slammed Paramount Skydance's threat to leave California, calling it leverage against an antitrust suit.

items.title: AI Music Generator Suno Strikes Licensing Deal With BMG as It Preps New Label-Backed Models
items.description: AI music generator Suno struck a licensing deal with BMG, adding a major label partner as it preps new models.

items.title: AI-Generated Turkish Series ‘Castle Walls’ Launches on Prime Video in What Is Being Touted as a Worldwide Streaming First – Trailer (EXCLUSIVE)
items.description: AI-generated Turkish drama Castle Walls launches on Prime Video, billed as the first end-to-end AI series on a major platform.

items.title: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's internal playthrough of The Elder Scrolls 6 disrupted by a giant inflatable rat, as Bethesda union protests cuts
items.description: Xbox CEO's internal preview of The Elder Scrolls 6 was interrupted by a giant inflatable rat as Bethesda workers protested cuts.

items.title: GTA 6 might not cost $100, but most of the people pre-ordering it are buying it at that price, Take-Two reveals
items.description: Take-Two says most GTA 6 preorders are for the pricier Ultimate edition even as debate rages over the game's cost.

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved struggles to sell in anywhere near the quantities the recent Black Ops revivals did, and the probable reason? Lack of multiplayer
items.description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is struggling to match recent Call of Duty remake sales, likely due to its lack of multiplayer.

items.title: Until Dawn and Little Nightmares 3 studio Supermassive announces further layoffs, with as many as 75 people expected to lose their jobs
items.description: Until Dawn studio Supermassive Games announced a third round of layoffs in three years, affecting up to 75 workers.

items.title: Leaked emails reveal Blizzard is Xbox's top-performing studio for FY26
items.description: Leaked emails reveal Blizzard was Xbox's top-performing studio in fiscal 2026, according to internal documents.

items.title: The birth of modern life was fueled by poop, new theory proposes
items.description: A new theory proposes that the Cambrian explosion, a pivotal moment for complex life, may have been driven by ancient waste.

items.title: Scientists are closer than ever to understanding the power of the vagus nerve
items.description: Scientists are gaining a clearer picture of the vagus nerve, the body's key highway linking the brain to major organs.
